description: Uses your only sponsored premium on a document of up to 50 pages. Keep evaluation.access_code as avaliacao_codigo and follow it with generation_status and agent_pass. A repeat returns the same access. Allowance per credential, until the earlier date of the agent's 30 days and the end of the pilot. Repeating the same document does not use another unit. Premium: keep evaluation.access_code and use X-Editalmd-Avaliacao together with X-Agent-Pass in the reads and in GET /geracao. Basic does not open premium content. The pilot depends on the global budget; no automatic renewal.

agent_pass.description: Persistent individual credential from POST https://api.editalmd.com/licitacoes/api/agente. It is not the User-Agent.

id.description: ID of the document in the collection.
